description: Request a Quo captain reservation. No account or payment needed to request, a person on our team confirms the request by phone, text, or email before it is final. Nothing is charged by this call. If the guest has already linked a card with a spending cap (see get_payment_method), reserve_and_pay can also complete payment in the same call instead of just requesting.

additionalRiders.description: Other named riders on this same booking, for a group/split-fare trip, the caller above stays the sole booking owner (auth, cancel rights, and payment all stay with them). Purely for the driver's manifest and, if a phone is given, that rider's own SMS ride updates. Not a separate payment, the organizer's card is still charged the full fare.

phone.description: Any common format is fine (e.g. "305-555-0100"); non-digits other than a leading + are stripped server-side.

dropoff.description: Destination, omit for an hourly/as-directed booking

flightNumber.description: For an airport pickup, Quo tracks the flight and the captain waits if it's delayed

idempotency_key.description: Optional. A unique string for this reservation request (e.g. a UUID). If the call is retried with the same key, the original reservation is returned instead of creating a second ride.

phone.description: Guest's mobile number, required, the concierge confirms by phone/text. Any common format is fine (e.g. "305-555-0100", "(305) 555-0100"); non-digit characters other than a leading + are stripped server-side.

stops.description: Ordered intermediate stops between pickup and dropoff within this one reservation (e.g. a hotel stop to grab a bag before continuing to the airport). Up to 3. Pricing here isn't distance-based, so each stop adds a flat surcharge to the fare, reflected in the confirmation.

name: reserve_ride
title: Reserve a Quo ride
